notes: *a man* is added under rule 17, the Hebrew writing an impersonal 3ms verb with an object suffix and no subject nominal.
*against* is the preposition the English verb writes to reach the bare object suffix and joins the verb's unit, the suffix keeping only *him* (rule 44).
`נֶגֶד` is unrepresented rather than fused with `יַעַמְדוּ`: its suffix keeps an English word of its own, so rule 40 governs and that rule's fusion carve-out is not reached.
`בִמְהֵרָה` → *quickly* is one fused unit headed on the noun carrying the lexeme (rules 23, 30).
